header.profileTitle: Click to view or change Mod Profiles
header.buildTargetCrossed: This profile is set for build {{target}}; the game installed now is {{installed}}. Saves never cross a major build. Switch Steam's beta branch to play it, or change the profile's build in Profiles.
header.buildCrossed: This profile was last played on build {{played}}; the game installed now is {{installed}}. Saves never cross a major build: a {{playedMajor}} save will not open on {{installedMajor}}. Switch Steam's beta branch back to play it.
header.buildOther: This profile was last played on build {{played}}; the game installed now is {{installed}}. A save from an earlier build usually opens on a later one of the same major; the other way round it does not.
header.buildSame: Installed build {{installed}}; this profile was last played on it.{{steam}}
header.buildUnknown: Installed build {{installed}}, from Zomboid/version.txt.{{steam}} Play this profile from the Studio once and it remembers the build.
header.conflictsTitle: Files several active mods ship at the same path. {{pending}} still need a decision, {{resolved}} are resolved or merged automatically. Click to open the Mod Merger.

DEBUG_FULLSCREEN.title: Debug Mode (Fullscreen)
DEBUG_FULLSCREEN.description: Launches in fullscreen with debugging (-debug), captures live logs and detects crashes.

DEBUG_WINDOWED.title: Debug Mode (Windowed)
DEBUG_WINDOWED.description: Same live debugging (-debug), but in windowed mode to view the app and game in parallel.

NORMAL_FULLSCREEN.title: Normal Game (Fullscreen)
NORMAL_FULLSCREEN.description: Standard native game in full screen (without -debug flag) for regular gameplay.

NORMAL_WINDOWED.title: Normal Game (Windowed)
NORMAL_WINDOWED.description: Standard native game in windowed mode (without -debug flag) for regular gameplay.

language.title: Language
language.blurb: The language the Studio speaks. English is the source; a language that misses a line shows it in English. The game's own messages (errors, warnings, the Monitor's log lines) stay as the game writes them.
language.contribute: Another language is one file: src/locales/<code>.json in the Studio's repository, proposed like anything else there.

profiles.title: Mod Profiles
profiles.blurb: Create and save custom mod combinations (e.g. Vanilla Plus B42, Brita + Weapons, Co-op Server) and switch between them with one click without losing your load order.
profiles.createBlurb: Create an independent profile to organize and save a mod combination.

profiles.buildSetTitle: Set by hand (Edit): the launch check and the header's Build badge go by it
profiles.playedOnTitle: The build this profile was last played on from the Studio
profiles.shareTitle: Save this profile to a file you can send to someone else
profiles.noneBlurb: Create your first profile in the left panel to save the current mod combination.
profiles.gameBuildLabel: Game build this profile is for
profiles.buildHelp: Saves never cross a major build. With a build set here, the Studio asks before launching this profile on another build, even before it has been played.
profiles.needName: Please enter a name for the profile.
profiles.noModsYet:
No mods found yet, so a profile saved now would switch all your mods off.

Set your game and Zomboid folders in App Settings first; the Studio will find your mods, and then a profile will remember them.
profiles.nothingTicked: Nothing is ticked, so this profile would switch every mod off. Tick the mods you want, or choose "Nothing yet".
profiles.confirmEmpty:
Create an empty profile?

Switching to it turns every mod off, which is what you want before subscribing to a new set. Your other profiles keep their mods.
profiles.activated: ⚡ Profile '{{name}}' activated successfully. Mods applied to the game!
profiles.sharedDescription: Mod profile shared from PZ Mod Studio
profiles.nothingToShare: This profile has no mods switched on, so there would be nothing to share.

profiles.confirmDeletePackages:
Delete the {{count}} patch package(s) this profile uses as well?

{{list}}

They hold merges made for this profile's mods. If you pick the same mods again later, the Studio works the compatibility out again from what is installed then.

Cancel keeps them.
